title: Brennan-Type Integrability for Crescent-Domain Conformal Maps
exact_target: Let $G$ be the bounded complementary component of a crescent domain and let $\phi:G\to\mathbb D$ be conformal. For which $\tau$ is $$\int_G|\phi'(z)|^{3+\tau}\,dA(z)<\infty$$ independently of $G$?
